_comment: Maps each skill to a bucket. Claude-Provision.ps1 installs only the selected buckets into ~/.claude/skills. Every skill stays in the repo regardless -- install a held-back bucket with -SkillBuckets, no re-clone needed. Skill cost is the description line only (always in context); bodies load on trigger.

_buckets.core: Workflow and repo skills. Planning, handoff, token efficiency, github, graphify.
_buckets.data: Analyst stack. Excel, data analysis, reconciliation, labour cost forecasting.
_buckets.powerbi: Power BI and Fabric. Model editing, Power Query, report authoring, dataflows.
_buckets.design: Wider visual/brand design. Overlapping taste skills, mobile screen mockups, brand kits, legacy v1. Held back by default -- enable with -SkillBuckets.
_buckets.web: SaaS and browsing. Supabase, Vercel, browser automation, trend research. Held back by default.
_buckets.webapp: Building and polishing web apps. Curated subset of the design skills: component patterns, UI audit, accessibility, visual direction, reference-image generation. On by default.
